# Documentation and attribution for the app icon

## Goal

Give maintainers a single documented source of truth: where the emblem lives,
how to regenerate every variant, the base-relative link convention, and its
licence.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, `README.md`, and `docs/DEVELOPER.md` (icon source path, `npm run generate:icons`, and the base-relative link convention).
- `public/assets/CREDITS.md` records the emblem's licence/attribution as original in-house permissively licensed artwork.

## Minimal Implementation

- Add a short "Application icon" subsection to `docs/DEVELOPER.md` covering the source SVG, generation command, and base-relative links.
- Add the icon entry to `public/assets/CREDITS.md`.
- Mention the generator in `README.md` where developer commands are listed (only where such a list exists).

## Deliverables

- `docs/DEVELOPER.md`, `public/assets/CREDITS.md`, `README.md`
data.title: Document icon source and attribution

# Cross-repo docs, commits and manual ToneForge verification

## Goal
Land the documentation, build/test verification, manual browser confirmation, and cross-repo commits for the ToneForge activation fix.

## Context
Per project rules, cross-repo changes are recorded in the sibling Worklog store where present; sibling pushes go to `dev` only. The engine carries the synth contract; the loader and scene wiring live in `../tce-main-street`. Companion indicator item CG-0MUTU0K17008HP35 provides the debug entry used for manual AC verification.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Code comments, README/docs (and any wiki/docs-site entries) are updated to reflect the activation fix and the missing-factory policy.
2. `npm run build` and the required test profiles pass (unit minimum; full suite on release).
3. Manual browser verification in both launch modes (engine `GAMES_CONFIG=main-street` and standalone `../tce-main-street`) confirms synth audio is audible and the debug indicator reads `Active` (or an equivalent `SoundManager` status check while the companion indicator item is incomplete).
4. Commits are pushed to `dev` (engine and/or sibling) with hashes recorded on the parent; any sibling submodule bump is noted.
5. Any sibling code change is recorded in the sibling Worklog store (or on the parent if absent).

## Minimal Implementation
- Update docs/comments.
- Run build + unit tests; full suite when releasing.
- Manual verification with the debug indicator / status check.
- Commit + push `dev`; record hashes and the sibling bump.

## Dependencies
Fix runtime wiring item; fallback/missing-factory item.

## Deliverables
Docs + commits recorded on the parent (and sibling worklog note).
data.title: Cross-repo docs, commits and manual ToneForge verification
